CHAPTER II · A LETTER FOR YOU
a letter from the lantern kingdom

For bby, who loves the lights 💌

Dear bby,

I know how much you love the lanterns, the flowers, and that little world where everything feels like a fairytale—and I wanted to make a tiny corner that carries some of that magic for you.

So whenever you wander through here, I hope you find something that makes you smile: a glowing lamp, a silly surprise, a hidden little detail, or just a reminder that you deserve days filled with warmth and wonder.

Keep dreaming about all the places you want to see and all the things you want to try. Keep getting excited over tiny things, keep being curious, keep laughing at your own random thoughts, and keep being exactly the kind of person you are. You don't need to be perfect or have every little thing figured out to make life beautiful.

If I could tuck a wish into every lantern in this sky, it would be that you get to experience more happy moments than you can count, that you always find kind people and peaceful places, and that even on ordinary days, something lovely surprises you.

This little kingdom is full of lights, flowers, games, and hidden things—but the whole point is simply to make you smile. Take your time exploring it. I made it with you in mind. ♡

May your sky always have a little light ✨

— from your co-conspirator in silly little surprises

the lantern boat
